pages.text:
**Right-click any small flower with a powder** to turn it into that element's flora: Ignis makes a Flora Ignis, Aqua a Flora Aquae, and so on. It starts with **16 essence** and uses up the powder. Xincraft's own exotic flowers can't be changed.

**Topping up:** more of its own powder adds 16, up to **64**. Other powders do nothing.

**Checking:** right-click with an empty hand, or look at it through [[rose_tinted_glasses]].

The fuller it is, the deeper its colour, the brighter it glows (up to light 8) and the more it sparkles.

**Breaking a flora destroys it**, essence and all. Pistons and flowing water break it too.
